executiveThesis.heading: From weekly AI output to an owned decision system
executiveThesis.lede: The team already has one recurring AI system that people use. The next step is not more disconnected capability. It is to connect customer evidence, weekly priorities, and production handoff while preserving human judgment.
executiveThesis.mondayChange: On Monday, the team reviews a current decision brief and approves exceptions instead of rebuilding context during the meeting.
executiveThesis.observedBasis: One system passes every qualification gate. Other packages, apps, and incomplete setup remain outside the current-system count.

currentOperatingModel.narrative: The weekly priority decision is the operating anchor. Growth owns the decision, strategy assembles interpretation, and production receives the result. The repeated friction sits in evidence assembly and the handoff after approval.

currentSystems.narrative: Only the weekly decision brief qualifies as a current operating system. The customer-language routine, installed capability, one-time app, and unfinished validation loop remain correctly classified outside this section.

futureOperatingModel.narrative: The recommended model turns one consumed weekly brief into a connected operating loop. AI keeps evidence current and prepares decisions. People approve meaning, priorities, claims, and production commitments.
